description: Haltestelle: Übersicht Bahnhofpläne Trafimage is a dataset listed in Swiss national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Schweizerische Bundesbahnen SBB. Bahnhofpläne liefern Informationen zum Ein-, Aus- und Umsteigen, zeigen die Serviceleistungen, das kommerzielle Angebot und die kombinierte Mobilität im und um den Bahnhof.Es gibt sie mittlerweile für mehr als 60 Stationen. Coverage: Switzerland. The portal files it under the publisher Schweizerische Bundesbahnen SBB. It offers 15 resource(s) in CSV, GPX, JSON, JSON-LD, KML. The portal shows 2026-09-15 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is opendata.swiss terms of use: open use, the source must be given. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support public transport network, service and demand studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-ch-portal.
